notices.short_title: Bid 2600003 - Firefighting Fittings - FDNY (Class 1, 3, 4)
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Firematic Supply Co., Inc. a $12,059,528 contract for firefighting fittings for the Fire Department of New York through a competitive sealed bid, in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Correction: 85726B0020-Bid2600022_Sheeting, Retroreflective Vinyl for Traffic Signs - Brand Specific
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids, through competitive sealed bidding, for brand-specific retroreflective vinyl sheeting for traffic signs, with responses due March 16, 2026, in a corrected solicitation.

notices.short_title: 25 Lenovo laptops for MOIA staff
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded BuyCheapCentral, Inc. a $22,500 contract for 25 Lenovo laptops for MOIA staff, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT TRAINING SERVICES
notices.plain: The Department of Correction awarded The Chad Carden Group an $858,000 contract for leadership development training services.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Shelter Services for Adult Families
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration intends to renew its contract for shelter services for adult families, with a response due Feb. 12, 2026.

notices.short_title: 82626B0023-BWT-JOC-26-SE Job order contract for North Plumbing
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids, due March 10, 2026, for a job order contract for plumbing work at North (the notice's title is "Job order contract for North Plumbing"), with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: 82626B0037-BEDC-CAT-452-E Catskills Aqueduct Chambers Restoration, Electrical
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids from pre-qualified vendors for electrical work on the Catskills Aqueduct chambers restoration, with responses due March 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: 82626B0035-BWT-1611-RDT (R2) Removal, Transportation and Disposal of Residuals from Various DEP WWRF and Other DEP Facilities
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids, due March 4, 2026, from companies to remove, transport and dispose of residuals from its wastewater resource recovery facilities and other department sites, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: 82626B0022-BWT-JOC-26-PWH Job Order Contract for WWRRF Facilities
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids, with the lowest qualified bid to win, for a job order contract covering construction work at wastewater resource recovery facility sites, with responses due March 5, 2026.

notices.short_title: 82626B0036-BEDC-CAT-452-G Catskills Aqueduct Chambers Restoration, General
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids for general construction services to restore chambers in the Catskills Aqueduct, with responses due March 18, 2026, and the lowest qualified bidder from a pre-qualified list will win.

notices.short_title: Development of the CPP's Faith-Based Sector Network
notices.vendor_name: New York Disaster Interfaith Services Inc.
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded New York Disaster Interfaith Services Inc. a $450,000 contract, chosen from competing proposals, to develop the CPP's Faith-Based Sector Network.

notices.short_title: Master Administrator for Non-Federally Funded Initiatives

notices.short_title: Provision of Shelter Services for Families with Children

notices.short_title: NAE_ Medical Services at PATH Intake Center's Clinic
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to award a human services contract for medical services at the PATH intake center's clinic through a negotiated acquisition, with responses due Feb. 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: Rent Reasonableness 80625N008
notices.plain: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development intends to award a rent reasonableness services contract through a negotiated acquisition, with responses due Feb. 20, 2026.

notices.short_title: Renewal of FileOnQ Software Maintenance and Support
notices.plain: The Department of Investigation intends to renew its FileOnQ software maintenance and support contract, with responses due Feb. 25, 2026, and the notice names no vendor or dollar amount.

notices.short_title: Information Technology (IT) Supplemental Staffing Services
notices.plain: NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals from vendors for information technology supplemental staffing services, with responses due April 10, 2026.

notices.short_title: City of New York Deferred Compensation Plan Auditing Services
notices.plain: The Office of Labor Relations is seeking proposals from firms to provide auditing services for the City of New York Deferred Compensation Plan, with responses due March 11, 2026.

notices.short_title: Caseload Explorer System Maintenance/Subscriptions/Consulting
notices.plain: The Department of Probation awarded a $408,852 renewal contract to Catalis Courts & Land Records LLC for maintenance, subscriptions and consulting on its Caseload Explorer System.

notices.short_title: Industrial Business Services Provider (IBSP) in North BKlyn
notices.vendor_name: Evergreen, Inc. - Your North Brooklyn Business Exchange
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services awarded Evergreen, Inc. - Your North Brooklyn Business Exchange a $170,000 contract to provide industrial business services in North Brooklyn, using a negotiated acquisition in which the city negotiated with one or a few vendors instead of open competition.

notices.short_title: Disposal Service for Recycled Asphalt Pavement {RAP) and Debris Removal Material Not Readily Suitable for Recycling Zones 1-4, Bronx
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation awarded Tully Environmental Inc a $1,668,450 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, for disposal of recycled asphalt pavement and debris not readily suitable for recycling in Zones 1 through 4 in the Bronx.

notices.short_title: Neighborhood Youth Team Sports and Youth Sports Education Fund Programs
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development intends to award human services contracts for neighborhood youth team sports and youth sports education fund programs, using a negotiated acquisition from a pre-qualified list of vendors, with responses due Feb. 12, 2026.

notices.short_title: Volunteer Management Software

notices.short_title: MWBE ENERGY EFFICIENCY MAINTENANCE
